declarations.source: Misra & Lu 1992; Hanor 2000, RiMG 40:193 — Elmwood barite records mixing between the Ba-bearing ore brine and an oxidized sulfate-bearing water; 106 ppm sulfate-S is a disclosed SIM-scale pulse floor, not a measured inclusion concentration

Misra & Lu 1992 and Hanor 2000, RiMG 40:193 support Elmwood barite paragenesis and episodic sulfate-fluid mixing but do not document clay or iron-oxide coatings on Elmwood barite; Grigor'ev 1965 and Sunagawa 2005 provide only the general mineral-ontogeny basis for this disclosed simulator hypothesis; 4 ppm Ba is a SIM-scale target, not a measured inclusion concentration
